name: Bloodied
effect_text: The first time you fall below half HP: +25% strength and +1 move for the rest of the battle.

name: Second Wind
effect_text: The first time you fall below half HP: +2 speed and +2 move for the rest of the battle.

name: Iron Wall
effect_text: After the 3rd hit on you, take 20% less damage for the rest of the battle.

name: Poise
effect_text: When you avoid an attack, your next attack gets +25% critical chance.

name: Crowd Pleaser
effect_text: When you knock out an enemy, +15% strength and defense for the rest of the battle (up to 2 times).

name: Heavy Is the Head
effect_text: When an ally is knocked out: +20% willpower and resistance for the rest of the battle, and your next attack deals +50% and can't be avoided.

name: Unflinching
effect_text: You and allies next to you cannot be knocked back, pulled or shoved.

name: Deadeye
effect_text: +5% hit chance and +3% critical chance for every hex between you and your target.

name: Imbued
effect_text: When you use an element, your next attack with that same element deals 25% more damage.

name: Royal Presence
effect_text: Allies within 2 hexes deal 10% more damage.

name: Guardian
effect_text: Allies next to you take 10% less damage.

name: Mana Veil
effect_text: Allies next to you roll their element resists with Advantage (roll twice, keep the better).

name: Scout's Lead
effect_text: Allies within 2 hexes get +1 move.

name: Bastion
effect_text: Double your glance chance, and glances against you deal 25% instead of 50%.

name: Crosstrained
effect_text: Add 25% of your second-best stat to your best stat.

name: Hardened
effect_text: Critical hits and weapon skills against you deal 15% less (a crit on you is x1.275 instead of x1.5).

name: Attuned
effect_text: +1 extra affinity point in any element you attack with.

name: Flair
effect_text: Your first attack each battle crits (if it lands clean).

name: Leap Ready
effect_text: +1 move.

name: Dragoon's Descent
effect_text: +10% damage and +8% critical chance for each level of elevation you stand above your target.

name: Unbowed
effect_text: You cannot be knocked back, pulled or shoved.

name: Acrobat
effect_text: The first attack on you each battle misses.

name: Sure Stride
effect_text: Muddy ground and water never slow you.

name: Quick Draw
effect_text: Once per battle, a weapon skill comes back 1 turn early.

name: Ammo Belt
effect_text: +1 range with bows and pistols.
